/bin/zsh -lc "mkdir -p docs/acceptance/t21438-runtime-deploy-readback/raw && (date -u '+started_at=%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'; go test ./internal/workerdaemon -run TestAcceptanceRuntimeDeployReadbackFailClosed -count=1 -v; rc="'$?; date -u '"'+finished_at=%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'; exit "'$rc) 2>&1 | tee docs/acceptance/t21438-runtime-deploy-readback/raw/go-test-runtime-deploy-readback.log'

/bin/zsh -lc 'set -o pipefail
mkdir -p docs/acceptance/t21438-runtime-deploy-readback/raw
SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current)
VERSION=runtime-deploy-${SHA:0:12}
BUILT_AT=$(date -u '"'+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')
{
  echo \"command=make build VERSION="'$VERSION COMMIT=$SHA BRANCH=$BRANCH BUILT_AT=$BUILT_AT"
  echo "started_at=$(date -u '"'+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')\"
  make build VERSION=\""'$VERSION" COMMIT="$SHA" BRANCH="$BRANCH" BUILT_AT="$BUILT_AT"
  rc=$?
  echo "finished_at=$(date -u '"'+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')\"
  echo \"exit_code="'$rc"
  exit $rc
} 2>&1 | tee docs/acceptance/t21438-runtime-deploy-readback/raw/build-candidate-binary.log'

/bin/zsh -lc 'set -o pipefail
EVDIR=docs/acceptance/t21438-runtime-deploy-readback/raw
RUNDIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ac-t21438-run.XXXXXX)
SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current)
CFG=$RUNDIR/config.yaml
SOCK=$RUNDIR/admin.sock
DB=$RUNDIR/agent-center.db
BLOB=$RUNDIR/blobs
KEY=$RUNDIR/master.key
LOG=$EVDIR/real-server-health-readback.log
cat > "$CFG" <<EOF
server:
  sqlite_path: "$DB"
  admin_socket_path: "$SOCK"
secret_management:
  master_key_file: "$KEY"
  skip_perms_check: true
blob_store:
  kind: local
  root: "$BLOB"
web_console:
  enabled: false
  listen_addr: "127.0.0.1:0"
EOF
printf '"'0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef\\n' > \""'$KEY"
chmod 600 "$KEY"
{
  echo "command=./bin/agent-center server --config=$CFG"
  echo "started_at=$(date -u '"'+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')\"
  echo \"worktree_branch="'$BRANCH"
  echo "worktree_sha=$SHA"
  echo "config_path=$CFG"
  echo "admin_socket=$SOCK"
  ./bin/agent-center server --config="$CFG" > "$RUNDIR/server.stdout" 2> "$RUNDIR/server.stderr" &
  PID=$!
  echo "server_pid=$PID"
  ok=0
  for i in $(seq 1 80); do
    TS=$(date -u '"'+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')
    RESP="'$(curl --silent --show-error --unix-socket "$SOCK" http://unix/admin/health 2>&1) && { echo "health_at=$TS"; echo "health_raw=$RESP"; ok=1; break; }
    echo "health_poll_$i=$TS rc=$? resp=$RESP"
    sleep 0.25
  done
  echo "server_stdout_begin"; cat "$RUNDIR/server.stdout"; echo "server_stdout_end"
  echo "server_stderr_begin"; cat "$RUNDIR/server.stderr"; echo "server_stderr_end"
  kill -TERM "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo "stopped_at=$(date -u '"'+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')\"
  echo \"exit_code="'$(( ok == 1 ? 0 : 1 ))"
  exit $(( ok == 1 ? 0 : 1 ))
} 2>&1 | tee "$LOG"'

/bin/zsh -lc 'set -o pipefail
EVDIR=docs/acceptance/t21438-runtime-deploy-readback/raw
RUNDIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ac-t21438-run.XXXXXX)
SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current)
CFG=$RUNDIR/config.yaml
SOCK=$RUNDIR/admin.sock
DB=$RUNDIR/agent-center.db
BLOB=$RUNDIR/blobs
KEY=$RUNDIR/master.key
LOG=$EVDIR/real-server-health-readback-rerun.log
cat > "$CFG" <<EOF
server:
  sqlite_path: "$DB"
  admin_socket_path: "$SOCK"
secret_management:
  master_key_file: "$KEY"
  skip_perms_check: true
blob_store:
  kind: local
  root: "$BLOB"
web_console:
  enabled: false
  listen_addr: "127.0.0.1:0"
EOF
openssl rand -base64 32 > "$KEY"
chmod 600 "$KEY"
{
  echo "command=./bin/agent-center server --config=$CFG"
  echo "started_at=$(date -u '"'+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')\"
  echo \"worktree_branch="'$BRANCH"
  echo "worktree_sha=$SHA"
  echo "binary_sha256=$(shasum -a 256 ./bin/agent-center | awk '"'{print "'$1}'"')\"
  echo \"config_path="'$CFG"
  echo "admin_socket=$SOCK"
  ./bin/agent-center server --config="$CFG" > "$RUNDIR/server.stdout" 2> "$RUNDIR/server.stderr" &
  PID=$!
  echo "server_pid=$PID"
  ok=0
  for i in $(seq 1 80); do
    TS=$(date -u '"'+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')
    RESP="'$(curl --silent --show-error --unix-socket "$SOCK" http://unix/admin/health 2>&1) && { echo "health_at=$TS"; echo "health_raw=$RESP"; ok=1; break; }
    echo "health_poll_$i=$TS rc=$? resp=$RESP"
    if ! kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then echo "server_exited_before_health=1"; break; fi
    sleep 0.25
  done
  echo "server_stdout_begin"; cat "$RUNDIR/server.stdout"; echo "server_stdout_end"
  echo "server_stderr_begin"; cat "$RUNDIR/server.stderr"; echo "server_stderr_end"
  kill -TERM "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo "stopped_at=$(date -u '"'+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')\"
  echo \"exit_code="'$(( ok == 1 ? 0 : 1 ))"
  exit $(( ok == 1 ? 0 : 1 ))
} 2>&1 | tee "$LOG"'
